Product type: Fermented tea beverage ❄️

Net weight: 300ml ⚖️

Origin: Guangzhou, China 🌍

IMPORTANT NOTICE ⚠️

For orders delivered outside Guangzhou, please refrigerate the bottle until fully chilled before opening.

Lower temperatures help slow the release of natural carbonation.

Pressure may build up during fermentation, so open carefully.

We recommend pouring into a glass before drinking.

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION 🧾

This is citrus brightness in a bottle.

Clean. Sparkling. Refreshing.

This lemongrass kombucha is traditionally fermented and infused with whole fresh lemongrass during the second fermentation.

The result is crisp, lightly tart, and refreshing — never overly sweet.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT 🌾

We stick to traditional fermentation.

Time, temperature, and real ingredients shape the final flavor.

The result is clean, citrus-forward, and naturally carbonated.

WHY SUGAR IS USED 🧪

Sugar is used only to support fermentation.

It serves as food for the kombucha culture, allowing fermentation to take place.

During the process, most of the sugar is consumed by the culture and converted into organic acids, carbonation, and flavor compounds.

Only a small amount of residual sugar remains in the final drink.

BRAND NOTE ✨

This product was previously sold under the GoVegan label.

The recipe has not changed.

The process has not changed.

It now carries the Roots name — and a clearer attitude.

INGREDIENTS 🌱

Filtered water, black tea, kombucha culture, sugar (<5%), fresh lemongrass

HOW TO DRINK 🥤

Serve chilled.

Open carefully due to natural carbonation.

Best poured into a glass before drinking.

Carbohydrate 5.0g

这款香茅康普茶采用传统发酵方式，在二次发酵阶段加入整根新鲜香茅。

以大豆为原料，经提取和加工制成高蛋白粉末。

不添加甜味剂、香精或其他成分。

配料简单，风味中性，适合日常饮食使用。

强调原料本身，而非多余加工。

为什么有人选择它

大豆蛋白属于常见植物蛋白来源之一。
蛋白含量高，适合用于补充日常蛋白摄入。
不含乳制品，适合多种饮食方式。
粉末形态，便于搭配饮品或料理中使用。 🌿
